amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D5/D6 canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-11) plus the eleven Fable addenda

WARMUP.note: features only; no brain is run and no DECISION event is written; one WARMUP status per observation

FROZEN.note: transient simulation on; eligibility accumulates and is never applied; OUTCOME settled for accounting as SETTLED_FROZEN; no LEARNING event; end checkpoint hash must equal start hash

clock.round_cadence: one decision round per regular-session minute bar at which any instrument reported a bar, taken at that bar's bar_end
clock.brain_clock: one decision cycle per round; DECISION_CYCLE_MS = 500 from flytrade/state.py
clock.eligibility_decay: once per round, in brain time, via the round's restored snapshot
clock.forgetting: MushroomBody.forget() is not called in the loop in any partition, as in Phase One and D4

clean_reference_checkpoint.note: no learning applied; not the odour-demonstration checkpoint

readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates over the k replicates, decoder applied once

FROZEN.why: amendment section 6: the comparison stimulus realisation must not change because the weights differ, so the learned-state digest is deliberately absent and both branches draw the same stream for the same observation

execution.cost_basis: per execution (charged on the entry and again on the exit); a completed round trip therefore costs 20 bps in total and no parameter is applied twice to one execution
execution.fill_rule: open of the first available regular-session bar with bar_start >= bar_end(decision), same session
execution.settlement_rule: open of the first available bar with bar_start >= fill.bar_start + horizon_minutes, same session
execution.delayed_fill_flag: DELAYED_FILL, with the elapsed market minutes
execution.entry_eligibility: bar_end(t) + 1 minute + horizon_minutes <= 16:00 on the same session (bar_start(t) <= 15:50); refused as POLICY_REJECT / SESSION_HORIZON
execution.session_close_rule: a position still open at its instrument's last available bar of the session is closed at that bar's close, flagged SESSION_CLOSE_FILL, close_reason POLICY_CLOSE, counted separately
execution.sequencing_guard: an entry may not fill before the previous exit filled
execution.no_invented_fills: a due fill or settlement without a valid price is a recorded Rejection, never a fabricated price and never a dropped episode
execution.reconciliation: gross_reference_pnl - fees - slippage = net_pnl, residual must be 0 to 1e-6

denominators: per candidate evaluation (one batch of k = 8 presentations)
per decision round (after selection among the round's candidates)
after inventory and execution constraints (what became an order)
statuses.silent_presentations_unit: presentation, counted separately from NO_RESPONSE batches

branches.name: reference
branches.note: untrained comparison; same observations, same baseline, same paper policy, same comparison_v1 seeds; separate account, journal and episode-id space

pass_conditions: P1 at least one OK observation per instrument in LEARNING, encoded inside the declared ORN drive budget
P2 more than one distinct normalised feature vector per instrument, and a non-constant Kenyon active fraction
P3 at least one DECISION event with readout_status VALID on a HISTORICAL_MARKET observation
P4 at least one EXECUTION event carrying that decision's episode_id
P5 at least one OUTCOME event settling that episode, with a net PnL and an ACCOUNT field
P6 at least one accepted LEARNING event with synapses_depressed > 0, and an end-of-LEARNING state digest different from the clean reference digest
P7 Journal.replay_chain returns ROUND, DECISION, EXECUTION, OUTCOME and LEARNING for at least one episode, from the log alone
P8 FROZEN learned branch: end checkpoint hash equals start hash, and zero LEARNING events
P9 accounting residual 0 to 1e-6 in every branch

compute_budget.reduction_rule: if the pre-run estimate exceeds 90 minutes, LEARNING is run on its last N sessions only, N the largest integer for which the total falls under 90 minutes; the dropped sessions are named in the report; WARMUP and FROZEN are never shortened; dates are never shifted; k is never reduced

runs.retry_rule: a retry after a software correction gets a new run id; the failed run's directory and its explanation are kept and reported
runs.discard_rule: a run started before the commit of this file is discarded and said to be discarded; likewise a run that read an adjusted or substituted dataset, or whose frozen-branch checkpoint hash moved

frozen_and_not_decided_by_this_run: the encoder channel rule, coding, drive budget 12000 Hz, carrier 0.10 and declared bounds
the decoder formula and its sign
the stored k = 8 baseline artifact, loaded at full precision
one normalised learning update per settled outcome
